about: A Go library for making and editing PDF files.

prs.title: Stamping a PDF no longer wipes the page's own text
prs.broken: Adding a stamp or overlay to a PDF made by LibreOffice or Ghostscript replaced the page's fonts, so the original text disappeared.
prs.changed: The page's own fonts and images are now kept and the overlay's are added next to them.
prs.matters: Watermarks and stamps can go on everyday office PDFs without ruining them.
